crossRefs.note: Moreover, in a pillar of cloud you led them by day; and in a pillar of fire by night, to give them light in the way in…
yet you in your manifold mercies didn’t forsake them in the wilderness. The pillar of cloud didn’t depart from over…

parallels.note: but if the cloud wasn’t taken up, then they didn’t travel until the day that it was taken up.

translations.web: Sometimes the cloud was from evening until morning; and when the cloud was taken up in the morning, they traveled; or by day and by night, when the cloud was taken up, they traveled.
translations.bsb: Sometimes the cloud remained only from evening until morning, and when it lifted in the morning, they would set out. Whether it was by day or by night, when the cloud was taken up, they would set out.
translations.kjv: And so it was, when the cloud abode from even unto the morning, and that the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they journeyed: whether it was by day or by night that the cloud was taken up, they journeyed.
translations.asv: And sometimes the cloud was from evening until morning; and when the cloud was taken up in the morning, they journeyed: or if it continued by day and by night, when the cloud was taken up, they journeyed.
